itemListElement.name: How to Remove Fireflies.ai From Teams, Zoom and Meet in 2026

mainEntity.name: How do I permanently remove Fireflies AI from Microsoft Teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delete or disconnect the Fireflies account that sends the bot, remove fred@fireflies.ai from invites, and have a Teams admin block the app in the Teams admin center under Teams apps, then Manage apps.

mainEntity.name: How do I kick Fireflies out of a meeting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the participant list, click the menu next to Fireflies and choose Remove from meeting, or type /ff leave in the meeting chat.

mainEntity.name: Why does Fireflies keep joining my Teams meetings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fireflies joins because an attendee connected their calendar with auto-join turned on. Ask the bot's owner to switch auto-join to Only when I invite, or remove fred@fireflies.ai from the invite.

mainEntity.name: Will removing Fireflies delete the transcript?

acceptedAnswer.text: If Fireflies is removed within the first 3 minutes, no transcript or notes are created. If removed later, the owner may still get notes for the part it recorded.

mainEntity.name: Can I block Fireflies without admin rights?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can remove it from meetings you organize and set your lobby so only organizers bypass it. Blocking it for the whole company requires a Teams admin.

mainEntity.name: Is Fireflies AI safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fireflies is a legitimate product with enterprise security options, including HIPAA and SSO on its Enterprise plan.
